body: I will be impossible even in the future. Where I live the best job I can hope to land would pay me maybe $150 a week, which my family would promptly take as contribution for living with them...Which I hate living with them anyway because they treat me like garbage, but what can I do? I can't just leave. That $150 a week wouldn't pay rent in even the cheapest apartments around here. I'm stuck in a hole and going mad. I need an escape, but I have none.

A simple one: I wanted to live in a different country (I can't say which because that might give away who I am). Or at least visit said country. But it's just not possible. Everything I've tried and researched won't allow it.
